title: 7/08 double-down leg never entered: check-pick-entered sent one 18:00 alert, then treated 'alerted' as terminal and never re-verified
tier_reason: entry/contest impact: one slot of the delivered double-down was not entered before the cutoff; the entry check went blind after a single alert

contract.text: Every slot of a committed pick (both double-down slots) is entered in the contest before the cutoff; once an entry alert fires, the check keeps re-verifying the account and escalates until it confirms an exact match or the cutoff passes.
contract.source: ARCHITECTURE.md 'bts check-pick-entered' (identity-verified: BOTH double-down slots; v3 'alerted is NON-terminal'); docs/audit/2026-07-09-gpt56-sol-audit.md F1

mechanism.text: after the entry alert the operator did not enter the double-down's second slot before the cutoff (a manual step outside the system)

check_pick_entered returned immediately when the day's marker status was 'alerted' (as for 'confirmed'), so after the single 18:00 DM every later */15 run exited without querying the account; the partial entry was never re-verified or escalated before the cutoff

code.symbol: check_pick_entered (prior status in ('confirmed', 'alerted') -> return; marker 'alerted' written after the DM)

residual.text: Any contest fetch/auth failure still skips quietly; if the account cannot be read through the window, re-verification and escalation do not happen and only the EOD pick_entry backstop (WARN alerted-past-cutoff, CRITICAL dm_failed) reports it.
residual.source: ARCHITECTURE.md 'bts check-pick-entered' (v3 'Transient auth outages keep the quiet-skip'; 'EOD backstop: the pick_entry health source')

residual.text: No postponed-game awareness: a pre-pitch postponement keeps nagging for a selection that will Pass (product call pending).

watchdog.trigger: for a scoreable commit, any */15 run between the first entry alert and the cutoff (first pitch − 5 min of the earliest selected game) that does not query the contest account, or a commit whose slots are not all an exact identity match in the account at T−15
watchdog.recovery_assertion: before the cutoff the account shows every delivered slot entered (exact match) and the marker records confirmed; otherwise the escalation tiers fired and the EOD pick_entry source flags the date
